vagas.descricao:
Mercor is partnering with a leading AI research lab to engage experienced **Market Research, Consumer Insights, and Marketing Strategy professionals** to act as **end-users of a cutting-edge AI product**. In this role, you will interact with the product as if you were using it in your day-to-day work—evaluating outputs, providing feedback, and helping improve how the system supports real-world decision-making.

* * *

### **What You’ll Do**

- Use an AI-powered product designed for:
 
 - Market research synthesis
 
 - Consumer insights generation
 
 - Marketing strategy recommendations
 
- Evaluate outputs from an **end-user perspective**, focusing on:
 
 - Relevance and usefulness of insights
 
 - Strategic quality and business applicability
 
 - Clarity, structure, and actionability
 
- Provide structured feedback and annotations on:
 
 - What works well vs. what doesn’t
 
 - Gaps, inaccuracies, or missing context
 
 - How outputs could be improved for real-world use
 
- Simulate real workflows (e.g., reviewing reports, validating insights, making decisions based on outputs)

* * *

### **Who We’re Looking For**

We are seeking professionals who regularly **consume, interpret, and act on market research and insights**, such as:

- Market Research Analysts / Managers / Directors
 
- Consumer Insights Managers / Leads
 
- Marketing Strategy / Brand Managers
 
- Product Marketing / Growth professionals with strong research exposure

**Requirements:**

- 3+ years of experience in market research, insights, or marketing strategy
 
- Current or recent experience at a **Fortune 1000 company, top consulting firm, or leading agency**
 
- Hands-on experience using insights to drive decisions (not just producing reports)
 
- Familiarity with:
 
 - Consumer research, segmentation, or survey analysis
 
 - Market sizing, competitive intelligence, or trend analysis
 
 - Translating insights into business or marketing strategy
 
- Strong critical thinking and ability to give clear, actionable feedback
 
- Fluent in English

* * *

### **Why Join**

- Influence how next-generation AI products are designed for real business users
 
- Act as a **true end-user voice** in shaping product quality and usability
 
- Flexible, low-commitment opportunity alongside your current role
 
- Opportunity for future product testing and feedback engagements

vagas.descricao:
About Turing:
 Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
 Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

 Role Overview: 
 Turing is partnering with a leading AI research lab to bring domain experts directly into frontier AI development. We are looking for PhD-level scientists in biology and the life sciences to work alongside the lab’s research teams, applying deep scientific expertise to advance and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. This is a chance to shape how the most advanced AI systems reason about science.

 Requirements: 
 • PhD in Biology or a Life Sciences field (e.g., molecular biology, genetics, biochemistry, cell biology, neuroscience, immunology, microbiology, bioinformatics/computational biology, or related).

• Hands-on research experience, ideally with peer-reviewed publications.

• Ability to create problems that are genuinely difficult, beyond textbook-level knowledge.

• Excellent written English and the ability to explain complex scientific reasoning clearly.

• Strong attention to detail and comfort working independently in a remote setting.
 Responsibilities: 
 • Design challenging, research-grade scientific problems and tasks that test the limits of frontier AI models and agents.

• Evaluate model and agent outputs for scientific accuracy, rigor, and reasoning quality, and give clear, structured feedback.

• Help build and refine benchmarks and datasets in your area of expertise.

• Identify where models fail on expert-level biology and explain why.

• Collaborate with researchers to translate scientific workflows into tasks AI systems can be trained and tested on.

• Adapt to evolving project scopes as research priorities shift.
 Nice to Have 
 • Experience with Python, R, or command-line tools for scientific computing or data analysis.

• Background in computational biology, bioinformatics pipelines, or lab-to-data workflows.

• Prior experience with AI training, evaluation, data annotation, or benchmark creation.

• Postdoctoral or industry R&D experience.
 Offer Details: 
 • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with 8 hours of overlap with PST.
 • Engagement type: Contractor
 • Engagement Length: upto 5 weeks
 Evaluation Process -
 • Application and profile review

• AI interview (mandatory)

About Turing 
 
 Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L
 
 Role Overview 
 
 We build hardware-engineering training data and benchmarks for frontier AI labs. As a front-end design engineer, you turn real RTL work into tasks that measure how well AI models design hardware: each task has a specification, a starting design, a reference solution, and the tests that grade it.
In this track, you will build the design tasks themselves: RTL design, bugfix, and PPA (power, performance, area) problems on real IP, graded with the same simulation, synthesis, and equivalence-checking flows used to tape out chips. This is fundamentally a front-end design role: you write RTL, take it through commercial and open-source synthesis, and can explain why the area, timing, and power came out the way they did.
The artifacts you produce become the ground truth these models learn from and are measured against. Your specifications, reference solutions, and tests shape what the next generation of models learns about digital design, so each one must hold up to the same scrutiny as a design going to tape-out.
 
 What does day-to-day life look like? 
• Author design tasks: Turn real IP into precise RTL design, bug-fix, and PPA‑optimization tasks: the specification, the starting point, and a reference solution that meets every requirement.
• Set the PPA bar: Run commercial and open-source synthesis to establish area, power, and timing baselines, and set targets that reward real engineering rather than lucky tool settings.
• Prove correctness: Build the hidden tests and equivalence checks a solution must pass, so no design can trade away function for a better number.
• Break your own tasks: Attack each task the way a model would (removed logic, constraint loopholes, untested corners) and close the gaps before it ships.
 
 Requirements 
• Education: BS/MS in Electrical, Electronic, or Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
• Experience: 3+ years of front-end digital design on ASIC or FPGA projects, from RTL through synthesis.
• RTL design: Fluent Verilog / SystemVerilog: microarchitecture, datapaths, FSMs, pipelines, FIFOs, clock-domain crossings, and clock gating.
• Synthesis and PPA: Hands-on logic synthesis with timing constraints. You read timing and quality-of-results reports and know which RTL or constraint change moves area, timing, or power.
• Commercial EDA: Hands-on commercial synthesis in industry, research, or project work: Cadence Genus, Synopsys Design Compiler / Fusion Compiler, or, for FPGA targets, AMD Vivado (including Vitis HLS flows).
• Open-source EDA: Hands-on open-source synthesis with Yosys, directly or through an OpenLane / LibreLane flow, and open-source simulation with Icarus Verilog or Verilator, directly or under cocotb.
• Verification: Self-checking testbenches in cocotb (Python) or SystemVerilog, and waveform-level debug.
• Scripting: Python and Tcl for flow automation; at home in Linux, Git, and Docker‑based environments. This is how every task runs.
 
 Perks of Freelancing With Turing 
 • Work in a fully remote environment.
• Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
 Offer Details 
 • Commitments Required: Minimum 40 hours per week with daily overlap of 4 hours with PST. 
• Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
• Duration of Contract: 2 months (adjustable based on engagement)
• Location: 
 
 Evaluation Process 
 • Delivery Interview
